crombolo login

Sign in to a remote with a code you approve in its back office. Each run acts again.

crombolo login [<remote>] [--no-browser]
ArgumentWhat it is
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.
--no-browserDon't open the approval page.

crombolo logout

Sign out of a remote, here and at the remote. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo logout [<remote>]
ArgumentWhat it is
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.

crombolo whoami

Who you are signed in as at a remote, and what you may do there. Changes nothing.

crombolo whoami [<remote>]
ArgumentWhat it is
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.

crombolo remote add

A remote this site pulls from and pushes to, kept in remotes.toml. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo remote add <name> <url> [--env <env>] [--force]
ArgumentWhat it is
nameA name for it: lower case letters, digits and dashes. Required.
urlThe site's URL. Required.
--envThe environment it goes to by default.
--forceReplace a remote of the same name.

crombolo remote job

Watch a pull or push job again, after a wait gave up. Changes nothing.

crombolo remote job <id> [<remote>] [--timeout <timeout>]
ArgumentWhat it is
idThe job id the wait printed. Required.
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.
--timeoutSeconds to wait before giving up. Default 1800.

crombolo remote list

The remotes in remotes.toml, and whether you are signed in to each. Changes nothing.

crombolo remote list

crombolo remote remove

Forget a remote; removing one that is not there changes nothing. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo remote remove <name>
ArgumentWhat it is
nameThe remote's name. Required.

crombolo pull

A copy of a remote environment: started here, or replacing this site. Each run acts again.

crombolo pull [<remote>] [--env <env>] [--full] [--yes] [--no-media] [--media-info-only] [--lazy-media] [--timeout <timeout>] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.
--envThe environment to pull.
--fullA full copy, people included: needs the permission for it.
--yesReplace this site without asking.
--no-mediaLeave the media files out.
--media-info-onlyFetch media files one at a time, only what changed.
--lazy-mediaFetch each media file the first time it is asked for.
--timeoutSeconds to wait for the remote before giving up. Default 1800.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo push

Replace a remote environment with this site. Each run acts again.

crombolo push [<remote>] [--env <env>] [--force] [--auto-approve] [--media-info-only] [--dry-run] [--timeout <timeout>] [--no-browser]
ArgumentWhat it is
remoteThe remote; the only one, when there is one.
--envThe environment to replace.
--forceGo on to a protected environment.
--auto-approveWith --force: don't ask for its name.
--media-info-onlySend media files one at a time, only what the remote lacks.
--dry-runSay what it would replace, and send nothing.
--timeoutSeconds to wait for the remote before giving up. Default 1800.
--no-browserDon't open an approval page.

crombolo bundle check

Read-only: what installing a bundle's content here would do. Changes nothing.

crombolo bundle check <bundle> [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--save]
ArgumentWhat it is
bundleA package directory, or the name of a bundle this site depends on. Required.
--underPlace the bundle under this page.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--allow-missing-blobsImport media items whose files the bundle does not carry.
--publishPublish what it imports.
--no-schemaDecline the schema the bundle carries.
--no-filesDecline the views, styles and scripts it carries.
--replace-filesAllow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert.
--saveWrite the answers into the bundle.

crombolo bundle install

Re-check, back up, then apply a bundle's content. Each run acts again.

crombolo bundle install <bundle> [--under <under>] [--resolve <resolve>] [--resolve-all <resolve-all>] [--allow-missing-blobs] [--publish] [--no-schema] [--no-files] [--replace-files] [--label <label>] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
bundleA package directory, or the name of a bundle this site depends on. Required.
--underPlace the bundle under this page.
--resolveAnswer a finding: <key>=take-bundle|keep-local|skip, or <key>/<property>[@<culture>]=take-bundle|keep-local.
--resolve-allAnswer every finding the same way. One of take-bundle, keep-local, skip.
--allow-missing-blobsImport media items whose files the bundle does not carry.
--publishPublish what it imports.
--no-schemaDecline the schema the bundle carries.
--no-filesDecline the views, styles and scripts it carries.
--replace-filesAllow replacing files this site has; the originals are kept for a revert.
--labelA label for the run.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo bundle purge

Back up, then drop a bundle's tables and clear its state. Safe to run again: a second run changes nothing more.

crombolo bundle purge <id> [--yes] [--dry-run] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
idThe bundle's id. Required.
--yesDon't ask: drop them.
--dry-runSay what it would do, and change nothing.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.
